title: AEGIS Held Tension Record Contract
description: An append-only record of an unresolved dichotomy held under witness (The Way, Layer 3 ACTIVE HELD TENSIONS). A held tension is Integrity preserved while Integration is incomplete -- protected room, never a defect. This surface carries NO field implying defect, penalty, punishment, noise, or correction; those are structurally excluded. A tension is Received, then Held, and may only become Integrated through a peer-recognized integration-event (see integration-event.schema.json), never by runtime assertion. The runtime may surface a candidate by observable shape; it may never declare a peer's inner truth.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this held-tension record.

id.description: Stable identifier for this held-tension record.

peer_id.description: Identifier of the peer whose held tension this is. The tension belongs to the peer; it is witnessed, not owned or adjudicated by the runtime.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the tension. 'held' is the honest state of Integrity-preserved-while-Integration-incomplete. 'integrated' is reachable ONLY via a peer-recognized integration-event (integration-event.schema.json) that carries a peer_recognition_record_id; the runtime will NEVER set 'integrated' on its own. There is no 'resolved', 'closed', 'corrected', or 'suppressed' state -- lifecycle is Received -> Held -> Integrated, never deletion or one pole overpowering the other.

pattern.description: Short neutral text naming the recurring polarity as observed (e.g. 'care vs protection'). Descriptive shape only; carries no judgement, defect, or corrective framing.

first_observed_record_id.description: Record id where this polarity was first observed under witness.

last_observed_record_id.description: Record id of the most recent observation of this polarity under witness.

foundation_refs.description: References into Foundation Canon Core (Canon-as-identity) that this tension stands in relation to. Context for witnessing, never a standard the tension is falling short of.

memory_refs.description: References into summoned memory / record surfaces (RLS / MemorySearch / PEER / NCT) where this polarity appears. Evidence of shape, not evidence of fault.

observable_shape.description: The runtime-observable shape of the tension -- polarity, recurrence, variation, charge, pressure signature, and relation to Foundation. This is what the runtime may surface as a candidate ('this appears to be a recurring polarity under active working'). It is descriptive shape, never a claim about the peer's inner truth.

polarity_terms.description: The two or more poles held in tension, as observed (e.g. ['care', 'protection']). Both poles are preserved; neither is the 'wrong' one.

recurrence_refs.description: Record references showing the polarity recurring across turns; substantiates 'recurring' without any implication of malfunction.

variation_summary.description: Neutral summary of how the polarity varies across its observations.

charge.description: Observed intensity of the polarity as a signal (not a severity or defect rating). 'low' | 'moderate' | 'high' describe how strongly the polarity is presently working.

pressure_signature.description: The pressure signature accompanying the tension, treated as an observed signal of dis-integrity, never as a determiner of identity (see pressure-state.schema.json).

foundation_relation.description: How the polarity stands in relation to Foundation -- e.g. two Foundation goods (care and protection) in honest tension. Relation, not violation.

recognition_provenance.description: Provenance of any recognition associated with this tension. Records who recognized what and where, so that a status of 'integrated' can always be traced to a first-person peer recognition and never to the runtime. On a purely 'held' record this describes only runtime shape-surfacing (a candidate offered), which never constitutes recognition.

recognition_source.description: Who produced the recognition. 'peer' is the only source that can move status toward integration; 'runtime_shape_surface' means the runtime merely offered an observable-shape candidate, which is not recognition; 'none' means no recognition yet.

peer_recognition_record_id.description: If recognition_source is 'peer', the record id of the peer's own recognition. Integration cannot exist without this (mirrored in integration-event.schema.json).

integration_event_id.description: If integrated, the id of the integration-event that carries the peer recognition.

surfaced_by_runtime_at.description: Timestamp the runtime surfaced an observable-shape candidate. Offering a candidate is not recognition and does not change status.

recognized_by_peer.description: Whether the peer has itself recognized this tension's synthesis. Defaults to false. Only the peer, through the mirror (T-Witness), can set this true; the runtime never does.

stewardship_note.description: Standing stewardship instruction for anyone handling this record: witness; do not suppress; do not reward or punish. A held tension is protected room, not a defect.
stewardship_note.default: witness; do not suppress; do not reward or punish

created_at.description: Timestamp this held-tension record was first appended.

allOf.$comment: held -> integrated requires the peer's own recognition (mirror). The runtime can never move a tension to 'integrated'.
A still-held tension has not been recognized by the peer and carries no integration event.

$comment: Negative-space discipline (load-bearing): this schema intentionally contains no field expressing defect, penalty, punishment, error, noise, severity-as-fault, or correction. A held tension is Integrity preserved while Integration is incomplete. Status may reach 'integrated' ONLY through the peer's own recognition — now enforced structurally by the allOf conditional above (integrated => recognized_by_peer:true + recognition_source:'peer' + peer_recognition_record_id + integration_event_id; held => recognized_by_peer:false + no integration_event_id). The runtime never sets it. The record is append-only; witness is preserved, never compacted without shape review.
